items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: Freddie Kemper and myself... we got on in, up there. And that's where the jazz, the Dixie, the jazz band.

ctx.x: Is that one of the reasons why I went to Chicago? Because pay was higher? Pay was higher.

And in the beginning, they're getting that after we got on there, Freddie Kemper and myself, and, and, uh, Marion Perrin's, we got on in, up there. And that's where the jazz, the Dixie, the jazz band. In other words, uh, they call it, uh, the jazz band.
